scenario1_missing_baggage_xray.zh:
您好：

這裡是國泰航空桃園機場辦公室。

由於您的寄艙行李未能通過桃園機場的 X 光安全檢查，機場安檢人員需要請您在場一同進行第二次檢查。因此，您的行李目前暫時留在報到櫃檯，未能安排裝載上機。

麻煩您盡快返回 4 號報到櫃檯，並與我們的職員聯絡。

如果您已經通過隨身行李安全檢查，但尚未辦理護照查驗，請先向現場桃園機場工作人員說明情況，再返回櫃檯確認您的寄艙行李。

如果您已經通過護照查驗，請與任何一位在登機閘口的國泰航空職員聯絡，我們會協助您跟進。

為了確保您的行李可以在航班起飛前順利完成檢查並安排裝載，麻煩您盡快返回櫃檯或聯絡國泰航空職員。

多謝您的理解和配合。
scenario1_missing_baggage_xray.en:
Hello, this is Cathay Pacific at Taoyuan Airport.

Your checked baggage did not pass the X-ray screening at the check-in counter, and airport security needs to conduct a second inspection with you. Your baggage is therefore being held at the counter and cannot be loaded at this time.

Please return to Check-in Counter 4 and contact our staff.

If you have passed security but not immigration, please inform the airport staff and return to the counter. If you have passed immigration, please contact our staff at the boarding gate.

Please contact us as soon as possible so we can arrange for your baggage to be loaded before departure. Thank you for your cooperation.

{cx flight/SEC/date}
scenario1_missing_baggage_xray.ja:
キャセイ航空 桃園空港です。
お預け手荷物がX線検査を通過できず、再検査が必要です。出国審査前の場合は、至急カウンター4へお戻りください。対応がない場合、搭載に間に合わない可能性がございます。
出国審査済みの場合は、搭乗ゲートのスタッフへお申し出ください。

scenario2_call_passenger.zh: 您好：這裡是國泰航空，我們結束登機時間是起飛前 15 分鐘，目前已經在最後召集中，請您儘速前往 {Gate} 號登機門。
scenario2_call_passenger.en: Hello, this is Cathay Pacific. Boarding closes 15 minutes before departure, and the gate is now making the final boarding call. Please proceed to Gate {Gate} immediately. Thank you.

scenario3_wrong_pickup.zh:
您好：

這是桃園機場國泰航空行李辦公室。

我們發現一件搭乘 {Arrival Flight} 抵達台北後無人領取的行李，該行李的行李牌號碼 {Bag Tag 1} 登記於您的名下。

目前另有一名旅客正在尋找一件外觀相似的行李。

請您協助確認您所領取的行李，其行李牌號碼是否為 {Bag Tag 2}？

您也可以直接拍攝您所領取行李的行李牌照片並傳送給我們確認。

為了避免耽誤您的行程，請您務必儘速聯絡我們，以確保您拿到的是正確的行李。

Email: tpe8bag@cathaypacific.com
Tel: +88627727630

謝謝您的配合。
scenario3_wrong_pickup.en:
Hello,

This is the Cathay Pacific Baggage Services Office at Taoyuan Airport.

We found one piece of unclaimed baggage from {Arrival Flight} arriving in Taipei. The baggage tag number {Bag Tag 1} is registered under your name.

Another passenger is currently looking for a similar bag.

Could you please confirm whether the baggage you collected has the baggage tag number {Bag Tag 2}?

You may also simply take a photo of the baggage tag on the bag you collected and send it to us for verification.

To avoid any disruption to your journey, please contact us as soon as possible so that we can ensure you have collected the correct baggage.

Email: tpe8bag@cathaypacific.com
Tel: +88627727630

Thank you for your cooperation.

Hello,

This is Cathay Pacific at Taoyuan Airport.

To allow more time for your connection in Hong Kong, as any delay to your flight {Disrupted Flight} from Taiwan to Hong Kong may affect your onward flight {Connecting Flight}, we would be pleased to offer you the option of taking an earlier flight from Taiwan to Hong Kong — {Alternative Flight}, departing at {Alternative Departure Time}.

If you are able to arrive at the airport before {Arrive Airport Before}, we can change your flight to an earlier departure to Hong Kong. Your onward flight from Hong Kong will remain unchanged.

We are located at Counter 4, Terminal 1 of Taoyuan Airport. Please contact our staff at the counter directly when you arrive at the airport.

Thank you for your understanding and cooperation.
